accent_reproduction_gap_note: The printed source marks accent throughout. A unit carrying none has dropped a real feature of the page, which two agreeing readers cannot detect between them.
merge_policy: No reading is synthesised from two disagreeing ones; a merged reading has no traceable source.
unstated_coordinate_note: Pairs the readers agreed on as units, but where one of them recorded a structural coordinate the page does not print. Counted here so the alignment is never silent; the coordinate disagreement is not evidence about the text and is graded only on the text.
